title: DP-Muon: Differentially Private Optimization via Matrix-Orthogonalized Momentum
abstract: arXiv:2605.12994v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study differentially private optimization with matrix-orthogonalized momentum. DP-Muon uses conventional global per-example clipping and one Gaussian gradient release per step; matrix updates and auxiliary updates are post-processing. Our main contribution concerns the additional mean distortion created when fresh Gaussian noise passes through a nonlinear matrix map. Conditioning on the actual adaptive history immediately before the current noise yields an exact Gaussian heat identity. For a smooth Newton-Schulz map, first-order DP-MuonBC reduces this conditional output bias from second to fourth order in the fresh noise scale, and an arbitrary-order extension has bias of order $2K+2$. We prove matrix-block stationarity bounds under global clipping, retain finite-step orthogonalization error explicitly, and give an exact criterion for improvement of the resulting upper bound. A separate inequality exposes the effect of auxiliary A

translated_title: DP-Muon：基于矩阵正交化动量的差分隐私优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究基于矩阵正交化动量的差分隐私优化。DP-Muon 采用常规的全局逐样本裁剪，每步仅释放一次高斯梯度；矩阵更新和辅助更新均为后处理过程。本文的主要贡献涉及新鲜高斯噪声通过非线性矩阵映射时产生的额外均值失真。以当前噪声之前的实际自适应历史为条件，可以得到一个精确的高斯热恒等式。对于平滑的牛顿-舒尔茨（Newton-Schulz）映射，一阶 DP-MuonBC 将该条件输出偏差从新鲜噪声尺度的二阶降至四阶，而任意阶扩展的偏差为 $2K+2$ 阶。我们证明了全局裁剪下的矩阵块平稳性界，显式保留了有限步正交化误差，并给出了改进所得上界的精确判据。一个独立的不等式揭示了辅助 A（摘要在此处截断，内容不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出 DP-Muon 差分隐私优化方法，通过基于实际自适应历史的高斯热恒等式分析，将非线性矩阵正交化映射引入的条件输出偏差从噪声尺度的二阶降至四阶，并证明了全局裁剪下的矩阵块平稳性界。
en_tdlr: DP-Muon is a differentially private optimizer with matrix-orthogonalized momentum that reduces conditional output bias from second to fourth order via an exact Gaussian heat identity, and proves matrix-block stationarity bounds under global clipping.
